Outcome: Depressive symptoms (lower is better)

## Study A
Found: benefit
Claim: Older adults deficient in vitamin D had higher odds of depressive symptoms than those with sufficient vitamin D, after adjustment.
Sentence: "The crude analysis showed that vitamin D deficient participants had 3.08 (CI = 1.53;6.20) times higher odds to present depressive symptoms compared to vitamin D sufficiency."
Measured as: depressive symptoms (15-item Geriatric Depression Scale)
Population: Community-dwelling adults aged 60 years and over from southern Brazil (EpiFloripa Aging Study)
Intervention: Serum 25-hydroxycholecalciferol deficiency (≤20 ng/mL), measured, not given
Comparator: Vitamin D sufficiency (≥30 ng/mL)
Design: cross-sectional study
Sample size: 557
baseline_vitamin_d_status: mixed

## Study B
Found: harm
Claim: In PD patients given vitamin D3, folic acid and B12 for 6 months, the 15D depression dimension score significantly increased (improved) from baseline.
Sentence: "After the intervention, the mean score of speech, mental function, discomfort and symptoms, depression, and QoL significantly increased (p < 0.05 for all)."
Measured as: depression (15D dimension score)
Population: Levodopa-treated Parkinson's disease patients in Romania, mean age 71 years
Intervention: Daily tablet with 800 IU vitamin D3, 1000 µg folic acid, 15 µg vitamin B12 for 6 months
Comparator: None (single-arm, baseline vs 6 months)
Design: case series
Sample size: not reported
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

content.text: {"rationale":"Both findings bear on vitamin D and depressive symptoms, but the observational deficiency association and the uncontrolled single-arm combination-supplement series differ in population, exposure, instrument and design, so they are not directly in conflict yet point different ways.","verdict":"genuine","reason":"design_or_bias","also_differs":["population","intervention","comparator","outcome_measure"],"detail":"design: cross-sectional deficiency association (n = 557) vs single-arm Parkinson's case series with vitamin D3 plus folic acid and B12 and no control"}
